components.name: Button
components.description: Primary action control. Daybreak v2: ember fill with ink text (4.8:1), mono 13px uppercase, 2px radius, no shadow. Secondary/outline use a hairline edge.
components.behaviourReason: Presentational. Uses Radix Slot only for asChild.
components.a11y: Focus-visible 2px outline (--ring, 2px offset). Disabled is pointer-events-none + opacity. Text on ember is always ink, never cream or white.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Square icon-only button. Requires a visible-name `label`.
components.behaviourReason: Presentational wrapper around Button.
components.a11y: Sets aria-label from `label`. Pair with Lucide at 1.5–2px stroke.

components.name: Link
components.description: Text link: foreground text with a 1px underline that turns ember on hover.
components.behaviourReason: Presentational.
components.a11y: Focus-visible 2px outline. Use asChild to render a router Link.

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text field.
components.behaviourReason: Native input is sufficient.
components.a11y: Pair with Label or Field. aria-invalid turns the border destructive.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text field.
components.behaviourReason: Native textarea is sufficient.
components.a11y: Pair with Label or Field.

components.name: Field
components.description: Label + control + help + error. Wires aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
components.behaviourReason: Label uses @ui-sdk/react/label. Field layout stays a Chamuka wrapper so Input/Textarea stay native.
components.a11y: Help and error ids are generated. Required fields get a visible asterisk marked aria-hidden.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Boolean choice with a Daybreak check indicator.
components.behaviourReason: Keyboard, mixed state, and form input come from @ui-sdk/react/checkbox.
components.a11y: Always pair with Label. Space toggles. data-checked styles the fill.

components.name: Switch
components.description: On/off setting.
components.behaviourReason: Role, keyboard, and form input come from @ui-sdk/react/switch.
components.a11y: Always pair with Label. Space toggles.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Single choice from a short list.
components.behaviourReason: Roving tabindex and form radios come from @ui-sdk/react/radio.
components.a11y: Name the group (aria-label or Field). Arrow keys move the selection. Pair each RadioGroupItem with a Label.

components.name: Select
components.description: Popup list of options.
components.behaviourReason: Typeahead, popup, and listbox keyboard come from @ui-sdk/react/select.
components.a11y: Name the trigger with aria-label or a visible label. Items need a value.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Searchable list of options.
components.behaviourReason: Filter, listbox, and popup come from @ui-sdk/react/combobox.
components.a11y: Name the input. Arrow keys highlight; Enter selects.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal task over the page. DialogContent includes the overlay.
components.behaviourReason: Focus trap, Escape, inert, and top-layer popup come from @ui-sdk/react/dialog. DialogPortal is a no-op: UI SDK popups do not use portals.
components.a11y: Always include DialogTitle. Escape and overlay press dismiss.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Non-modal floating panel.
components.behaviourReason: Placement, dismissal, and focus come from @ui-sdk/react/popover. PopoverAnchor is a presentational span; pass `anchor` on content for custom anchors.
components.a11y: Name the content if it has no title.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: Action menu from a button. Wraps UI SDK Menu behind the Chamuka names.
components.behaviourReason: Keyboard, typeahead, and popup come from @ui-sdk/react/menu. DropdownMenuPortal is a no-op.
components.a11y: Arrow keys move; Enter selects; Escape closes.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Short hint on hover or keyboard focus.
components.behaviourReason: Delay, placement, and hover/focus open come from @ui-sdk/react/tooltip. TooltipProvider is a no-op kept for API stability.
components.a11y: Keep copy short. Do not put essential information only in a tooltip.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: One panel visible at a time. TabsTrigger/TabsContent alias UI SDK TabsTab/TabsPanel.
components.behaviourReason: Roving tabindex and arrow keys come from @ui-sdk/react/tabs.
components.a11y: Give TabsList an aria-label. Each trigger and panel share a value.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Expandable sections. defaultValue accepts a string or string[].
components.behaviourReason: Heading structure, keyboard, and disclosure come from @ui-sdk/react/accordion.
components.a11y: Triggers report aria-expanded. Put the trigger inside AccordionHeader.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient notification. useToast().toast({ title, description, variant }).
components.behaviourReason: Queue, timed dismissal, and announcements come from @ui-sdk/react/toast via createToaster. ToastViewport is a compatibility no-op; ToastProvider places ToastRegion.
components.a11y: Errors are announced assertively. Do not steal focus.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline status message. Hairline edge on a surface fill; status variants add an 8px signal dot, danger turns the edge ember. No tinted fills or side bars.
components.behaviourReason: Presentational. role=status.
components.a11y: Uses role=status. For blocking confirmation use a Dialog.

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface grouping for forms and summaries. 1px hairline edge, 4px radius, no shadow; CardTitle is condensed uppercase display.
components.behaviourReason: Presentational.
components.a11y: CardTitle is an h3. Do not nest headings out of order.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small mono uppercase label with a 1px edge and 2px radius. Status variants add an 8px signal dot.
components.behaviourReason: Presentational.
components.a11y: Do not rely on colour alone.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Image with initials fallback.
components.behaviourReason: Image load/error fallback is still @radix-ui/react-avatar. Not a keyboard/ARIA behaviour primitive; UI SDK Avatar was left unused to keep this presentational.
components.a11y: Fallback text should be initials, not a name sentence.

components.name: Separator
components.description: Horizontal or vertical rule.
components.behaviourReason: Decorative vs semantic orientation still uses @radix-ui/react-separator. UI SDK Separator exists; kept Radix to avoid pulling UI SDK into a presentational primitive.
components.a11y: decorative=true by default.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholder.
components.behaviourReason: Presentational. aria-hidden.
components.a11y: aria-hidden. Pair with a live region elsewhere if needed.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate loading indicator.
components.behaviourReason: Presentational.
components.a11y: role=status and aria-label=Loading. motion-reduce:animate-none.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Flex stack with gap variants.
components.behaviourReason: Layout only.
components.a11y: No inherent role.

components.name: Container
components.description: Centered max-width wrapper.
components.behaviourReason: Layout only.
components.a11y: No inherent role.

components.name: ThemeProvider
components.description: Sets data-theme (and .dark/.light) on a wrapper so Daybreak v2 roles resolve. Defaults to system; dark when there is no preference.
components.behaviourReason: Theme class + context only.
components.a11y: Does not trap focus. Wrap the app once.
